title: When the banjo came in
summary: Banjo was already popular when he started; earlier guitar; Marrero praised.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Do you remember when the banjo first came in? Or I guess when you were a boy, it was already popular?
I was already popular when I came in.
In the real old days, they used guitar mostly.
Well, yeah, I understood because I heard his record by Louis Armstrong with his Hot 5 during them times. Johnny Sincere was playing the guitar. They didn't have no banjos then, I don't remember.
You didn't mention one of the very best, Marrero.
George Dino talks a lot about him. He's his favorite, I believe, in those days. He talks about a couple others, too.
